label: Bible Study
prompt: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the _____.
verse: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
note: Christ didn't wait for us to get strong — he died for the ungodly.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He brought me forth also into a _____ place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verse: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
note: God brought David out into a large place — simply because He delighted in him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of _____.
verse: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
note: The statue in Nebuchadnezzar's dream had a golden head — and feet of iron mixed with clay. Not a sturdy base.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy _____ from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
verse: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
note: Before Jericho, Joshua meets the captain of the LORD's host and gets Moses' burning-bush instruction.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will _____ purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verse: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
note: Not a typo: 'throughly' is the KJV's old form of thoroughly. John the Baptist's winnowing fan leaves nothing unsifted.
